items.exampleEn: Stop mumbling and speak clearly, please.
items.exampleZh: 別再含糊不清了，請說清楚。

items.exampleEn: Several broadcasters want to show the final game this year.
items.exampleZh: 今年有好幾家廣播電視公司想轉播決賽。

items.exampleEn: The buzz of the old fridge kept me awake all night.
items.exampleZh: 舊冰箱的嗡嗡聲讓我整晚睡不著。

items.exampleEn: She overheard her boss saying that the company might move.
items.exampleZh: 她無意中聽到老闆說公司可能會搬遷。

items.exampleEn: This camera has a powerful zoom, so you can see faces from far away.
items.exampleZh: 這台相機的變焦功能很強，所以你可以從很遠的地方看清楚人臉。

items.exampleEn: Please write a funny caption for this picture of our cat.
items.exampleZh: 請幫這張我們家貓咪的照片寫一段好笑的說明文字。

items.exampleEn: Which browser do you use on your computer?
items.exampleZh: 你的電腦用哪一個瀏覽器？

items.exampleEn: The owner emphatically refused to sell the old house.
items.exampleZh: 屋主斷然拒絕賣掉那棟老房子。

items.sentenceEn: He mumbled something about being tired and went to his room.
items.sentenceZh: 他咕噥說自己很累，就回房間了。

items.audioEn: If the website looks strange, try opening it in a different browser.
items.audioZh: 如果網站看起來怪怪的，試著用另一個瀏覽器開啟。
items.questionZh: 說話者建議網站看起來怪怪的時候怎麼做？
options: Close the website and try tomorrow

items.sentenceEn: Be careful what you say on the train, because other people can overhear you.
items.sentenceZh: 在火車上說話要小心，因為別人可能會聽到。

items.sentenceEn: My phone buzzed twice during the meeting, but I didn't answer it.
items.sentenceZh: 開會時我的手機震動了兩次，但我沒有接。

items.stemEn: The photo in the newspaper had a short ____ under it explaining who the people were.
items.stemZh: 報紙上那張照片下方有一段簡短的說明文字，介紹照片中的人是誰。

items.stemEn: I didn't mean to ____ your conversation, but you were talking quite loudly.
items.stemZh: 我不是故意聽到你們的談話，但你們講得相當大聲。

items.passageEn: Last year, a national broadcaster started adding captions to all of its news programs. The idea came from a viewer who often watched the news on her phone's browser in quiet places like the library, where she could not turn the sound on. Some reporters also mumble when they speak quickly, so the captions help everyone. At first, the captions were often wrong. In one report about bees, the word "buzz" appeared as "bus." The broadcaster's manager emphatically promised to fix the problem, and the team hired more editors to check unfamiliar names and words. Now viewers can even use the zoom on their screens to make the captions bigger.
items.passageZh: 去年，一家全國性的廣播電視公司開始為所有新聞節目加上字幕。這個點子來自一位觀眾，她常在圖書館這類安靜的地方用手機瀏覽器看新聞，在那裡不能開聲音。有些記者講得快時也會口齒不清，所以字幕對每個人都有幫助。一開始，字幕常常出錯。在一則關於蜜蜂的報導中，「buzz（嗡嗡聲）」這個字被打成了「bus（公車）」。電視公司的經理強調一定會修正這個問題，團隊也多請了編輯來檢查不熟悉的人名和字詞。現在，觀眾甚至可以用螢幕的縮放功能把字幕放大。

questions.questionZh: 那位觀眾為什麼需要字幕？
options: 她家的電視喇叭已經壞了很久
她想靠看新聞多學一些英文單字
她常在不能開聲音的地方看

questions.questionZh: 經理對字幕出錯的問題做了什麼？
options: 承諾會修正並多請編輯

items.promptZh: 她斷然地說，她再也不會回那家餐廳了。
referenceEn: She said emphatically that she would never go back to that restaurant.
She emphatically said she would never return to that restaurant.
rubricZh: emphatically 可放在動詞前或後（例如 emphatically said、said emphatically 等）
「再也不會」可寫，例如 would never、will never 等
「回那家餐廳」可寫，例如 go back to、return to 等

items.instructionZh: 用 zoom 造一個句子，說說你拍照時怎麼使用變焦功能。
referenceEn: I used the zoom on my phone to take a photo of the moon.
I often use the zoom to take pictures of birds in the park.
rubricZh: zoom 當名詞（例如 use the zoom、the zoom on my camera 等）或寫 zoom in 都可以
時態配合內容（例如 used、often use 等）
